narr: A strong monsoonal moisture push led to afternoon thunderstorms with heavy rainfall leading to flash flooding in Cheyenne and Laramie and areas in-between.
ev: Received reports via social media of water completely covering roads and coming over curbs and sidewalks in northwest Laramie west of Interstate 80.
Emergency manager reported 4th Street in downtown Laramie was underwater.
Received reports via Facebook of outbuilding surrounded by water and garages flooding.

NWS Employee reported the disc gold course along Dry Creek was under several feet of moving water. Received numerous public reports that Dry Creek had breached its banks and is overflowing into nearby areas.
Received report via Facebook of numerous dirt roads under water along with overflowing drainage ditches.
